jobDescription: The platform company retires old API versions on a published schedule, and every deprecation touches hundreds of external developers. The Program Manager runs each deprecation programme: the deprecation plan and the developer communication schedule, the weekly status report to the platform leadership, the coordination of the API teams' migration guides and tooling, and the closure with the traffic evidence that the old version is unused. Shutdown dates are set by the platform leadership. The role requires taking hostile questions from external developers at the monthly developer call. Reports to the head of platform programs; works with the API teams, developer relations and the platform leadership.
requirements: Runs API deprecation programmes under the platform's program method, including the deprecation plan and the developer communication schedule.
Answers external developers' questions at the monthly developer call under the communication standard.
Coordinates the API teams' migration guides and tooling through the program tracker.
Prepares shutdown readiness, with shutdown dates set by the platform leadership, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents program boundaries and traffic evidence at closure.

evidence.text: Program manager at a platform company for three years, running five API deprecation programmes under the platform's program method with their deprecation plans and developer communication schedules.

Answered the external developers' questions at thirty-two monthly developer calls under the communication standard; the call transcripts and the follow-up logs are in the developer relations archive, with every open question answered in writing within the standard's five days.
Coordinated the API teams' migration guides and tooling through the program tracker, with the guide and tool readiness recorded against each deprecation milestone.

Prepared the shutdown readiness review for each deprecation; the shutdown dates were set by the platform leadership, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which the API teams'.
Wrote the closure report for each programme with the program boundary statement and the traffic evidence that the old version was unused, accepted by the head of platform programs.

Work sample: one deprecation plan with its communication schedule, two developer call transcripts with follow-up logs, one shutdown readiness review with the leadership's date decision and one closure report, with the archive references as a verification trail.

Interviewer 2 note: given a hostile question from a panel member playing an external developer, the candidate restated the question in the developer's terms, gave the shutdown date and the migration guide section that covered the developer's case, said which two items were not yet decided and when they would be, and offered to follow up in writing within five days.

Reference call with the former head of platform programs: confirmed the candidate ran the five deprecations and the developer calls in the period, that shutdown dates were set by the leadership, and confirmed the dates.
